title: Provenance site index
description: The declarations a site says it publishes, served at https://<host>/.well-known/provenance/index.json. A pointer for discovery, never proof: every listed declaration is verified at its own location.

site.description: The host serving the index; must equal the host it was fetched from.

operator.description: The site operator's own provenance id.

agents.description: At most 1,000 entries; a reader ignores the rest.
